title: Squash (Chappal Kadoo): modeled ₹355/qtl left, Dhanotu (Mandi) → Kullu
summary: February 2022: reported squash (Chappal Kadoo) prices at Dhanotu (Mandi) and Kullu imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 75% of 16 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹355 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 2 same-variety market pairs screened for squash (Chappal Kadoo) in February 2022; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kullu report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: February 2022
scenes.caption: Dhanotu (Mandi) (Himachal Pradesh) and Kullu (Himachal Pradesh) both reported squash (Chappal Kadoo) prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 16 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Dhanotu (Mandi) reported a median ₹2,050 per quintal. Kullu reported a median ₹2,800 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹700/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹700 per quintal, and Kullu was dearer on 88% of days.

scenes.headline: 86 km by road
scenes.caption: 86 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~2 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹18/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹432 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹291 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kullu report, the rule selects 13 of 16 modeled shipping days. 11 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹355 per quintal (₹213 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Squash (Chappal Kadoo) route from Dhanotu (Mandi) to Kullu was positive on 75% of matched days in February 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹35,500, or ₹21,300 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to squash (Chappal Kadoo)
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹18/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Squash (Chappal Kadoo) route from Dhanotu (Mandi) to Kullu was positive on 75% of matched days in February 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹35,500, or ₹21,300 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

sources.title: Agmarknet / data.gov.in daily mandi modal prices (retained AGRINET snapshot)
RBI Working Paper WPS (DEPR) 08/2024 — Price Dynamics of Tomato, Onion and Potato
